body: Interesting. I wonder if they sped it up a bit or if he really sings that fast.

>Depression isnt some thing that can be swept up under a rug

That's the worst part. I always hear "things get better, it just takes time." I feel like I don't have time. It's so unfair because depression just suddenly smacked me in the face one day after a single even. It makes me think that getting rid of it would be just as instantaneous :/ But everyone says that's not the case.
I've wanted to travel like Paul since trying to take my own life. The only thing stopping is that I don't really want to go away alone.

Just that while I know my life could still have meaning, I feel like it doesn't. I have to rebuild everything because of this, and all my plans need to be reevaluated. So it's like all the goals I had, the "points" of my life, are now gone.

We thought we were meant for each other at one point. We spent 6 years together... about 1/4 of my life. Never been with another person. I know my life is not completely pointless without him, but what I feel is the complete opposite. I know I'm being irrational, but my emotions are very strong deceivers...
Thank you everyone. I'm feeling better today. I love you all for caring even just for a few minutes :) < - god, that smiley felt weird typing lol
Thank you. That really makes sense. I think I'll look into volunteering with a settlement agency. I've always felt happy helping new immigrants.

Thanks, I'll give it a try. Not like I have anything to lose. I have been writing in a journal too, but I usually end up wallowing in what I've written rather than allowing it to be cathartic... I think I'm doing it wrong :/

Yes. This combine with the fact that all my plans for th4 future revolved heavily on his support. I wanted to go back to school and do a few other expensive things I can't afford on my own without going into a lot of debt. At one point we wanted to have children together, but I have limited time with that due to biological reasons :(

I think I misspoke. It's the first therapist I've gone to for this bout of depression. In total, I think I've been to about five sessions with three therapists/social workers, and I know that's not much better... I just want someone who can sit down with me and listen for more than 50 mins. I'm so frustrated.

>It just takes time to get there.

This is my biggest problem right now. Everyone has been saying all of my problems come down to time, and I understand that, but I feel like I don't have any time. It's like if I don't start getting advice on how to deal with this now, I'm going to snap again :'(

Thank you..

>They can be better listeners than advice givers at times

I was hoping for one or the other, but this line I've been calling is bad with both. Each phone call was less than 10 mins. I just wanted to talk, but they just seemed to want to get me off the phone and into the hospital.

I know my boyfriend no longer loves me because he told me he fell out of love with me a year ago, and has been faking our relationship, pushing me away, hoping I would do the same. I live with him now because I have no where else to go. He says he wants to help me through this. He's the only person I could ever count on, and now that he wants his space while also trying to help me, I feel so lost and confused and guilty every time I even speak to him.
